body.purpose: Paragraph text; dense captions and provenance use local 11px rules.

motion.name: inference-spinner
motion.purpose: Pending inference status; reduced-motion media query removes transitions and reduces animation duration to .01ms.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Explicit analysis or workflow action; disabled until its prerequisites exist.

components.name: Spatial source badge
components.description: Persistent disclosure attached to the illustrative canvas.

narrative.northStar: Approved white three-panel workbench; no additional creative metaphor approved.
narrative.overview: White bordered instrument panels, restrained blue actions and a copper active navigation state refine the approved workbench. Public Sans Variable supports compact labels and tabular values. Source imagery, checkpoint provenance and visible limitations govern the presentation.
keyCharacteristics: Dedicated phase identification, accuracy and simulator workflows

rules.name: Separate colour meanings
rules.body: Mineral class colours, synthetic geological domain colours and interface state colours remain independent.

rules.name: Flat by default
rules.body: Borders and tonal fills structure UI panels; tiny shadows belong to selected segments and the canvas mode badge.

dos: Do keep source and checkpoint labels with results.
Do identify procedural geology as synthetic and unlinked to S2 images.
Do distinguish uncalibrated confidence from recorded accuracy.
Do show simulator scope and actual response.
donts: Don't invent assays, grade, recovery gains or inferred orebody geometry.
Don't imply that the current analysis sample is located at a demo point.
Don't claim local records are cloud synced.
